The %bias column of Table IV prints unsigned values, so the direction of effect is taken from the printed baseline and final INR means. Study conclusion: "all bias values remaining within Fraser's acceptable limits, confirming their suitability for routine coagulation testing". Discrepancy preserved: the printed %bias (0.9%) and the value calculated from the printed baseline and final INR means (0.0%) do not agree — both are kept, neither reconciled. The printed means are given to 2 decimal places, which limits the resolution of the calculated value.
